enchantments.tooltip: Insightful Seeker +6: Provides a +6 Insight bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +6 Insight bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Insightful Doublestrike 6%: Passive: 6% Insight bonus to Doublestrike. (Doublestrike is a chance to score an additional hit with a melee attack.)
Extra Smite: You have one additional Smite Evil use per rest. You must rest to gain your initial charge.
Charisma +13: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +13 Enhancement bonus to Charisma.
Mythic Wrist Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
